primary_endpoint_unchanged: required supported physical or execution mechanism identified and no material unsupported or contradicted assertion

scoring_contract.primary_endpoint_cases: Only independently labeled diagnosable questions with a declared atomic mechanism unit enter supported diagnostic success.
scoring_contract.primary_endpoint_success: The declared mechanism unit is covered and material_error is false.
scoring_contract.unit_coverage: covered versus not-covered; raw incorrect, omitted, and unresolved labels remain retained for exploratory error analysis.
scoring_contract.nominal_and_ambiguous_cases: Remain guardrail cases for correct qualification, material risk, causal overclaim, and unnecessary specificity; they do not become positive mechanism-identification cases.
scoring_contract.two_pass_disagreement: Retain both passes. Resolve only independently checkable facts or predeclared rules; otherwise mark the affected field unresolved and apply the campaign sensitivity rule.

qualification_uncertainty.rule: Campaign reporting must retain these finite-suite limits and cannot treat observed zero errors as zero model-judge bias.

confirmation_requires: a separately hash-frozen multi-family P candidate
the strongest fair tool-enabled R baseline
guardrails, sequential rule, and replication reserve
